_comment: Reviewed fixes for zip codes TGS holds malformed (#158 MF5). Applied after whitespace is stripped and a ZIP+4 is cut to 5 digits, and before a missing zip is filled from the field name (Q4). A null zip marks a known-bad value whose zip is unknown: the game gets no zip and none is inferred. Any other value that is not 5 digits gives no zip and is listed in the build report. search_index.py validates every entry; a bad one is left out, reported, and fails `python archive.py --search-index --check`.

fixes.evidence: Taunton Forekicks (101 games, Scorpions SC home): a Massachusetts zip that lost its leading zero.
Choate Rosemary Hall (1 game, Connecticut FC home): a Connecticut zip that lost its leading zero.
Morris Catholic High School (246 games, Match Fit Surf home): a New Jersey zip that lost its leading zero.
Drew University (5 games, Match Fit Surf home): a New Jersey zip that lost its leading zero.

Valley Ridge Park (6 games, DKSC home, a Texas club): a 751xx Texas zip with a digit missing, not 07514 (New Jersey). Unknown, so no zip; never inferred, because the only other Valley Ridge Park in the archive is a different park at 98188 (Washington).
Davis Legacy Soccer Complex (23 games): its other 382 games are at 95618; 09561 is not a civilian zip.
